item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Mon Dec 7, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment (1 hour) — Tue Dec 8, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: YOUTUBE/FACEBOOK - MICHAEL SHAWN AND THE TAKEOVER LEGENDS PODCAST: WEDNESDAY WORD — Wed Jan 6, 8:00 AM — NJ
item.description:
Every Wednesday at 8 AM on Michael Shawn & The Take Over Legends, Lady Renaissance (aka KT) brings the poets to you! The Wednesday Word is a live weekly segment featuring some of the dopest poets in the spoken-word community — for raw interviews, panel discussions, and conversations that go beyond the page. Curated by Kierstin Tonic (Lady Renaissance), co-founder of Lyrics To Go and curator of community arts spaces, The Wednesday Word is where the open mic meets the podcast. Live. Unfiltered. On purpose. Catch it live every Wednesday at 8 AM on YouTube and Facebook — or catch the replay and share the word! Source: NJ Poetry Events

If anyone joining this event would like to place an order, let us know, we can pitch in.

For those interested in chess: I'm cross promoting this with another group event that's happening at the same time and place, so feel free to jump in with them. Check out "North NJ Tournament Chess Masters in Training."
See you there!
NOTE: If you are not attending the event, please change your RSVP accordingly!

item.description:
Join Oren Davis on Zoom for an open, welcoming conversation about this week’s Torah portion. In Vayishlach, Jacob prepares to face his brother Esau after twenty years apart. The night before they meet, he wrestles with a mysterious stranger until dawn and comes away with a new name: Israel, “one who struggles with God.” What does it take to face someone we’ve wronged? item.title: GivingTuesday: Friends Fundraiser — Tue Dec 1 — Nutley Free Public Library
item.description:
December 1, 2026
Friends of the Nutley Public Library invite you to participate in GivingTuesday, which kicks off the generosity season and inspires us to give back to our community.
Please consider donating on December 1, 2026, and throughout the year by clicking here: DONATE.
GivingTuesday was launched in 2012 as a simple idea: to create a day that encourages people to do good. GivingTuesday has funded countless causes around the world and encourages residents to get involved in their communities.
Our cause is supporting the Nutley Public Library by funding Summer Reading Programs for kids, museum and art passes, musical performances, author meet-and-greets, learning new crafts and skills, just to name a few. Please visit friendsofnutleypl.membershiptoolkit.com to learn more about the Friends and becoming a member. You can also stop by and visit the Nutley Public Library at 93 Booth Drive, Nutley, NJ.
Thank you!
As President of the Friends of the Nutley Public Library, I

item.title: 2026 Class Gift Tabling - Day of Giving Information and Philanthropy Cord Pick-Up — Tue Dec 1, 12:00 PM — Student Center 2C02 - 2nd Floor Lobby
item.description:
Each year, our graduating class participates in a proud Class Gift tradition where members of the class invest in the University by supporting areas of Montclair State University that are most important to them. We invite the Class of 2026 to come together to show your support! All gifts to Montclair count! Make your gift to any area of campus you feel most passionate about – such as the Emergency Book Fund, The Red Hawk Pantry, your school or college, The Fund for Montclair State or athletic program. Your gift will pay it forward for future Red Hawks and kick-start your philanthropic connection to Montclair.
Commemorate your class year! Make a gift of at least $20.26 and you’ll receive your customized philanthropy cord to wear over your commencement robe. item.title: Fasting and Prayer Group for Christians Online — Thu Dec 3, 7:37 PM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Let’s join together in the meetup group chat to plan and discuss a 3 day water fast. We can decide if we want to fast for a common cause. There is power in prayer and fasting for Christians and even more so when we come together to do it. Just like in the Book of Esther; while her people were being persecuted, they came together to do a 3 day fast and call out to the Lord. God heard their cries and flipped the situation so they ended up benefiting from an event meant to wipe them out. \* This is not a weight loss program. \* I’m not a medical professional and can’t tell you if you are able to only drink water for 3 days. You should consult with your doctor. \*We can join the meetup’s event chat every Thursday to talk and plan. \*I’m open to ideas and suggestions, just message me and let me know, or leave a comment. \*Let me know if you have any questions.
